 Dated this the 9th day of January, 2025

Order 
Standing counsel takes notice for the 2nd respondent.
Policy is admitted.
Hence notice to 1st respondent is dispensed with.
2. This is an application filed by the appellant praying for condoning the delay of 149 days in filing the appeal.

Mohanan.M vs Vipina.M on 9 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/48040481/
1 3.
The application was opposed on the ground that sufficient ground was not stated for condoning the delay.
4. The petitioner filed the above appeal claiming enhancement of compensation in respect of injuries sustained in a motor vehicle accident.

Considering the fact that this appeal relates to claim for compensation under the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, I hold that the delay of 149 days in filing the appeal can be condoned on condition that the petitioner shall waive the interest for the enhanced amount of compensation awarded, if any, for the period of delay in filing the appeal.
5. In the result, this application is allowed on condition that the petitioner will not be eligible for interest for the enhanced amount of compensation, if any, in appeal.
MACA Appeal is admitted.
Post for hearing.

Sd/-
C. PRATHEEP KUMAR, JUDGE sou.
